decision.question: Has the mug identified in the source image been moved to the right of the headphones in the edited image?
decision.criteria: Pass if comparison of the source and edited images establishes that the source mug has been relocated to the right of the headphones. A separate right-side mug alone is insufficient. Fail if the source mug can be identified and remains left of the headphones or otherwise has not reached the requested position, or if clear visual evidence establishes that a different mug was added instead of moving the source mug. Return unknown if blur, occlusion, or ambiguous correspondence prevents determining the source mug's identity or final position. Execution or transport failures are not visual evidence of failure.
decision.binding: Track the source image's blue mug, initially left of the black headphones with its handle facing left, into the edited image using its visible appearance and scene correspondence. Compare that mug's final position with the headphones in the edited image. Inspect the blurred blue region on the left and both white mug-like objects without automatically substituting the rightmost mug for the source mug.
